prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Mirelle Vane. Character visual motifs: sharp-eyed **adult mage girl (early twenties)**, needle-hair comb, short asymmetrical ink-black sleeve, ivory structured waistcoat, oxblood petal-skirt over practical shorts, flat boots, giant folded-paper pattern cape. Her floating helper is a brass bobbin, **not three elemental spheres**.
TOP LEFT: Pattern Memory. Ability concept: Mirelle can maintain **three visible 2-HP tailor pins** at once, each lasting 6 s and anchored to traversable ground; new pins replace the oldest. Two or three pins establish a line/triangle with clear world-projected stitch geometry. Valid layouts must leave legal passage and cannot cross impassable world walls.
TOP RIGHT: Pin the Hem. Ability concept: tosses a pin within 125 GU, causing a small impact sting only if it hits a target; the pin stays on the ground. At least one pin is required for most pages. Pins are marked for **both** teams and can be broken by 2 basic attacks.
BOTTOM LEFT: Recut. Ability concept: chooses one existing pin and slides it along a visible, collision-valid 40-GU path after a 0.4 s warning. Enemies crossed by the moving thread take one light hit; recasting on empty ground fails without consuming the cooldown. Also cycles the selected **page group** when no pin is targeted, with no cast or mana cost.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Pattern Book. Ability concept: hold/activate a **radial palette** of ten named patterns; choosing a page is input selection, then releasing R makes **one authoritative cast**. Each page has its own cooldown, cost and geometry requirement. The global weave lockout is a post-cast throttle, **not an 80-second ultimate imposed on all ten pages**. Major pages have longer personal cooldowns. A single chosen page cannot be released if its pin geometry or cooldown is invalid; show the reason before committing. Each successfully cast page consumes **exactly its declared pins**.
